pair.title: Pair with Remote Play
pair.description:
Enter your Remote Play account ID, or [sign in to PlayStation]({login_url}) and paste the resulting redirect URL. On the awake PS5, open Settings > System > Remote Play > Link Device and enter its eight-digit PIN below.

**To turn on the PS5 from rest mode**, open Settings → System → Power Saving → Features Available in Rest Mode and enable **Stay Connected to the Internet** and **Enable Turning On PS5 from Network**.

error.cannot_connect: No verified response from the console.
error.wrong_console: A different PlayStation 5 answered at this address.
error.invalid_pin: Enter the eight digits shown on the console.
error.choose_account_method: Enter either the account ID or the sign-in redirect URL.
error.invalid_account: The account ID or sign-in redirect could not be used.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Open Link Device again and use a fresh PIN.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup is already in progress for this console.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovery request could not be sent.
abort.no_discovered_devices: No unconfigured PlayStation 5 responded. Start setup again and try entering its IP address.

passcode.title: Console profile passcode
passcode.description: If your console user has a four-digit login passcode, enter it here. Leave the field empty to clear a saved passcode.

start_pairing.title: Start pairing
start_pairing.description: Submit to open a pairing prompt in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_passcode: Enter four digits or leave the field empty.

pairing_required.message: Pair the console before using power control.

power_unconfirmed.message: The console did not confirm the requested power state.

passcode_required.message: Set or correct the console profile passcode in the integration options.

cannot_connect.message: The configured console could not be reached.

command_failed.message: The console rejected the Remote Play command.

console_asleep.message: Wake the console before opening the home screen.
